objective: Define and validate the product-owned Persian-first RTL design system, terminology, semantic-state tokens and directionality rules before operational screen implementation.
scope: Define canonical light and dark theme tokens
Define spacing, radii, elevation, breakpoint, density and typography scales
Define semantic state tokens for success, warning, critical, stale, degraded, no-trade, disconnected and pending
Define Persian-first terminology with canonical English identifiers
Define RTL shell and LTR financial island policy
Bind the canonical Figma design-system source
tests: All P23 design-system contract tests pass
Light/dark body text contrast is at least WCAG 2.2 AA 4.5:1
Every semantic state light/dark pair is at least 4.5:1
Every semantic state has label and icon cues
Spacing/radii/breakpoint scales are ordered and canonical
RTL shell and LTR financial island policies are exact
P23-B evidence is byte-identical across two runs
rollback: Revert P23-B design-system/config/tests/evidence/CI/state changes; P23-A remains canonical complete and P23-C remains unstarted.
definition_of_done: Canonical Figma design-system source is linked
Strict CI and deterministic evidence pass
